reserveReview.rationale: Scoped October 31, 2026 23:59 UTC backing review from the report published November 5, fetched November 19. Total reported backing is $1,996,189.05 against $1,894,175.36 USDh (105.39% coverage, matching the report's stated ratio). The Ethereum Settlement Wallet holds $545,947.39, of which 5,003.00 STRCx are worth $495,947.39 at $99.13 per share, leaving $50,000.00 unitemized. Clear Street custodies $502,241.24, itemized as 5,000 STRC shares worth $495,650.00 at $99.13 plus $6,591.24 USD. Copper holds $812,489.98 in aggregate including unrealized P&L, without instrument weights; Ceffu holds $0. The Stacks Redeeming Reserve holds $35,362.33 unitemized; the Reserve Fund holds $100,148.12 USDC and $0.00 USDh. Percentages are independently calculated against reported total backing and rounded to six decimals. Location amounts sum to $1,996,189.06; the one-cent discrepancy is reporting rounding, not a balancing asset or favourable coverage claim. October adds the Clear Street location and rebalances the book: STRCx falls from 67.1% to 24.84% while unitemized Copper rises to 40.70%. Clear Street's STRC is the directly held listed share, not the STRCx wrapper, so it is classified public-credit with the conservative high tier (STRC is unlisted in the canonical symbol map, consistent with the STRCx and STRCon treatment) and an unknown liquidity horizon because the report states no liquidation or settlement terms; the Clear Street USD balance is cash with the same unstated-horizon treatment. The STRCx slice retains the over-seven-days horizon recording the May 8, 2026 final-terms redemption restrictions (KYC before acceptance, five Business Days to instruct payment, postponement under underlying illiquidity), not a guaranteed settlement maximum or measured liquidity; the perpetual instruments have no finite maturity maximum, so no numeric maturity is invented. Copper's subtotal carries a signed custodian balance attestation within its stated scope; Clear Street's is supported by its monthly brokerage statement, and the $502,241.24 subtotal follows Hermetica's reporting basis (the statement shows $6,591.23 trade-date cash and a separate $3,150.06 accrued balance that Hermetica excludes); the whole book, legal safeguards and hedge reconciliation are not independently attested.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The September 30, 2026 report identifies $472,573.22 at Copper and $0.00 at Ceffu, plus the new Ethereum Settlement Wallet 0x1046a6AD45B60264c83A4b93F6D2c6078C73c1d5, Stacks Redeeming Reserve and Reserve Fund. Copper Markets (Switzerland) AG signs a scoped off-exchange custody balance attestation covering aggregate BTC, USDT and USDC, not whole-protocol liabilities or legal holder safeguards. The settlement wallet contains $1,396,969.74 of STRCx credit-instrument backing, but its remaining assets, the Copper asset split and Stacks Redeeming Reserve contents are unitemized. Wallet key control, account-level segregation, insolvency terms and rehypothecation protections remain unknown. The custody amounts cited here are from September 30, 2026; custody unknowns remain separately charged.
